summary: North Miami should keep a standalone municipal control row. Official city and county sources show an active North Miami Police Department as the city's primary general-policing authority, and FDLE's official county-and-municipal offense reports publish North Miami Police Department as a normal municipal row in 2020 and 2021. The current all-fill condition therefore reflects broken state-publication and repo-ingestion continuity on FL0131800, not an invalid target or sheriff-primary service structure.
